transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too, doctor. Well, I suppose what brings me in is... my eating habits. 

Once I start picking at the leftovers late at night, I just can't seem to stop myself. It feels like the sensible part of me is right there saying, 'That’s enough, Alejandro,' but my hand just keeps going back for more anyway.
After eating this way, do you ever deliberately try to make up for it by vomiting, fasting, exercising, or using laxatives?

No, I don't do any of that. I just... feel bad about it the next day, but I don't try to throw up or starve myself or anything like that. I might tell myself I'll eat less the next day, but I don't actually do any kind of fasting or taking pills.
How often do these episodes happen?

Well, looking back on it... I'd say these late-night leftover episodes have been happening at least once most weeks. Often it's two nights a week. It really started up like this ever since my cousin moved in.
How long have these episodes been happening at least once a week?
I'd say it's been going on for about four months now. That's right around the time my older cousin came to live with us, so... yeah, it's been about four months of this.
During these episodes, do you eat an unusually large amount of food—more than most people would eat in similar circumstances?

Yes, I'd say so. Some nights after supper, when I'm supposed to be putting away the leftovers, like the tamales or the mole... I'll end up eating several servings. And then I'll take some pan dulce out to the garage and eat that, too. It's definitely a lot more than I'd ever put on a plate if the family was sitting there watching me.
During these episodes, do you eat much more quickly than you normally would?

I don't think so, no. I mean, I'm not really rushing through it or eating faster than usual. I'm just out there in the garage, taking my time with it, really. It's more about how much I'm eating, not how fast.
During these episodes, do you keep eating until you feel uncomfortably full?

Yeah, I do. I don't usually get to the point of being sick, but I definitely eat enough that my belt feels tight. I usually just have to sit there in my workshop chair for a while because my stomach gets so uncomfortable.
During these episodes, are you physically hungry when you start eating, or do you sometimes eat even when you are not hungry?

Well, a lot of the time I'm not even hungry. I mean, I already had a good dinner with everyone, so I shouldn't be. But later on, when I'm cleaning up, I still find myself opening the containers and just... tasting one thing after another. So, yeah, I definitely eat even when I don't have an appetite.
